result.topic_en: Riemann's case analysis of how a discontinuity in the gas-dynamic initial data (two constant states u_1, ρ_1 and u_2, ρ_2) resolves into compression shocks and/or rarefaction waves, with conditions on u_1−u_2 and the densities, followed by scratch calculations (cases I, II, III) for the isothermal case f(ρ)=a log ρ.
